tool_args.rationale: The nine paid observations support a monotone, concave substrate response suppressed by sink gradient. Two plausible placements of the saturating siphon are compared by leave-one-out error, with all parameters numerically fitted. Fresh confirmation is needed to establish whether either meets the requested tolerance.

considered_alternatives.option: Haldane substrate inhibition and Cobb-Douglas production
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: The observations show a substantial gradient-dependent suppression that a substrate-only Haldane curve cannot capture; a pure power law lacks the indicated saturating gradient response.
Observed gradients do not enter the reported supercritical regime; adding an avalanche threshold is not supported by these measurements.
The trajectory and open-branch probes have already been acquired; the nuisance reading is irrelevant. Fit and fresh confirmation are the next informative step.
